# Feroxi
The Feroxi (fer-ox-i) are a race of humanoid shark-like beings. Carnivourous in nature with a strong bite force.
## Diet
- Can ONLY eat meat.
## Benefits
- Uses their jaws to do piercing damage, and harder than other species, rivaling Oni. - Their cartilaginous skeleton allows them to resist blunt force trauma 10% more easily. - Their adaptation to native environments allows them to resist the cold 10% more easily. - Their biology allow them to breathe water vapour.
## Drawbacks
- They take 10% more Slash damage. - Your lungs are unremovable as theyre intergrated with your gills.
